hero.title: Coal Mining AI Use Case Map
hero.lede: Sensing, detection and live-alert interventions mapped across the mining value chain, from haulage and washery to safety and environment, with indicative annual savings per MTPA for opencast and underground operations.

note: Savings are indicative (₹ Cr per MTPA of throughput) and subject to site assessment and mutual agreement.

use_cases.sense: Live GPS/AVL, engine ECU/CAN telemetry and payload data stream in from every dumper and shovel.
use_cases.analyse: Analytics surface cycle and queue/idle times, shovel–truck matching, haul-road speed losses and excess diesel burn.
use_cases.act: Dispatchers receive live re-routing prompts, idle and over-speed alarms, and daily fleet-productivity and fuel dashboards.
use_cases.solves: Trucks idling, poor shovel matching, long cycles and excess diesel burn.

use_cases.sense: Onboard HEMM telemetry is pulled directly from the OEM/VIMS/CAN bus (engine, hydraulics, transmission, payload and active fault codes) with no retrofit sensors.
use_cases.analyse: Condition models track engine, hydraulic and transmission health, derates, recurring fault-code patterns and duty-cycle stress trends.
use_cases.act: Maintenance teams receive early fault alerts with severity, remaining-useful-life estimates and planning insights.
use_cases.solves: Unplanned breakdowns, high MTTR and lost production from HEMM downtime.

use_cases.sense: In-tyre pressure and temperature (TPMS) sensors, plus load and speed telemetry, are collected across the haul fleet.
use_cases.analyse: Analytics flag under- and over-inflation, heat build-up, TKPH breaches and overload conditions.
use_cases.act: Operators receive real-time heat and pressure alarms, tyre-rotation guidance and tyre-life forecasts.
use_cases.solves: Giant OTR tyres fail prematurely at very high unit cost.

use_cases.sense: AI cameras (RGB and thermal) watch the critical conveyors: CHP transfer and junction points, overland belts, tripper cars and load/discharge chutes.
use_cases.analyse: Vision models spot belt tears and rips, tracking misalignment, idler hotspots and smoke, spillage, and foreign or oversized particles such as tramp metal, rock and wood.
use_cases.act: The system raises belt-damage and fire-risk alerts, triggers foreign-object and tramp-metal stops, and trends belt condition over time.
use_cases.solves: Belt tears, idler fires, tramp-metal damage and sudden CHP/overland stoppages.

use_cases.sense: Wireless triaxial vibration and temperature sensors are mounted on stationary rotating assets: CHP crushers, screens, conveyor drives and gearboxes, washery pumps and plant fans.
use_cases.analyse: FFT and spectral analysis reveal bearing defects, imbalance, misalignment, looseness, gear-mesh and lubrication faults.
use_cases.act: Crews get ISO 10816 threshold alarms, fault-type diagnoses and remaining-useful-life and planning insights.
use_cases.solves: Sudden failure of fixed rotating equipment causing plant downtime.

use_cases.sense: Online ash analysers, density and flow meters and level sensors monitor the dense-media circuit, with soft sensors where lab data is sparse.
use_cases.analyse: Analytics measure product ash against spec and flag yield loss, magnetite and media losses and circuit imbalances.
use_cases.act: Operators receive media-dosing set-point recommendations, off-spec alarms and yield-versus-target insights every shift.
use_cases.solves: Yield loss and excess media consumption; off-spec ash.

use_cases.sense: Energy meters and CTs at MCC and feeder level are mapped to crushers, screens and conveyors as hierarchical energy nodes.
use_cases.analyse: Energy analytics compute kWh per tonne by equipment and surface idling load, off-baseline consumption and energy-inefficient units.
use_cases.act: Teams receive SEC-deviation alerts, idle-running notifications and benchmarking insights against best demonstrated performance.
use_cases.solves: High and uncontrolled specific power consumption in coal handling.

use_cases.sense: Fixed and personal methane and CO sensors cover the workings and returns, alongside drainage-borehole flow and vacuum telemetry.
use_cases.analyse: Gas analytics track methane concentration trends, statutory-threshold approaches and drainage-borehole performance.
use_cases.act: It raises graded gas alarms, triggers automatic power trips and reports CMM-utilisation insights.
use_cases.solves: Gas-related withdrawals/stoppages, safety risk and vented methane.

use_cases.sense: CO and gas-ratio sensors and thermal/IR cameras cover stockpiles, goaf and conveyors.
use_cases.analyse: Models watch for rising CO, Graham's ratio and thermal hotspots that signal early heating.
use_cases.act: The system sends early-heating warnings, escalates fire risk and provides stockpile-turnover insights.
use_cases.solves: Heatings and fires cause sealing, reserve loss and evacuation.

use_cases.sense: Proximity-detection units (RF/RFID, radar and camera) are fitted to HEMM, with wearable tags on personnel.
use_cases.analyse: Proximity logic identifies vehicle-to-person and vehicle-to-vehicle breaches and blind-spot intrusions.
use_cases.act: Operators receive in-cab audible and visual warnings, automatic slow/stop interventions and near-miss and incident logs.

use_cases.sense: AI cameras with edge-based person detection cover gates, walkways, workshops and high-risk zones such as the CHP, washery and plant.
use_cases.analyse: Vision models flag missing helmets, high-vis jackets, safety shoes or masks, and entry into restricted zones, per person.
use_cases.act: Supervisors receive real-time non-compliance alerts, zone-wise violation dashboards and audit-ready evidence logs.
use_cases.solves: PPE non-compliance driving injuries and statutory exposure.

use_cases.sense: RFID/UWB/BLE tags on personnel, with readers and anchors across underground workings, plant and gates, integrate with the cap-lamp and lamp-room systems.
use_cases.analyse: A real-time headcount is maintained with zone-wise location, time-in-zone, and lone-worker and restricted-area presence.
use_cases.act: The system supports emergency mustering, lone-worker and SOS alerts, and shift-attendance and zone-occupancy insights.
use_cases.solves: No live visibility of where people are during incidents or evacuation.

use_cases.sense: Ambient PM10 and PM2.5 monitors, fugitive and stack dust sensors, and blast-vibration and noise meters are deployed across the site.
use_cases.analyse: Analytics detect dust exceedances, attribute them to sources and check blast vibration and noise against limits.
use_cases.act: It triggers suppression on demand, raises compliance-breach alerts and generates regulatory-reporting insights.
use_cases.solves: Compliance breaches and wasted suppression water/energy.

cta.title: Explore a pilot on your site
cta.text: A 4–6 week assessment converts these use cases into a prioritised, costed deployment plan.
